messages:
maya_pm: starting a short thread to align on a new 'auto-pin rollover' product RFC. goal: let pins expire with a controlled canary + tenant preview + opt-in credits. want to lock minimum launch criteria and owner tasks.

aj_dev: implementation Qs: where does the canary evaluation run (research infra vs product infra)? need tenant-level opt-out and an API to store rollover config under pin metadata.

sasha_research: we can repurpose onboard suites but should create a lightweight nightly runner: bench id onboard-standard-lite. must add embedding-stability and a small p99 perf check.

maya_pm: proposed launch gates: 1) canary bench pass (onboard-standard-lite), 2) p99 latency delta <= 2%, 3) embedding cosine drift <= 1%, 4) per-token cost delta <= 10%. include legal exclusion for explicit pin clauses.

lucas_support: add communications cadence: notify tenants at 30d/14d/7d before TTL expiry with preview link and opt-in toggle. offer credits for tenants who allow auto-roll. SEs should have 'run canary now' in console.

aj_dev: config sketch for pin metadata: ```yaml
rollover:
  ttl_days: "90"
  canary_pct: "1"
  bench: "onboard-standard-lite"
  warmup_prefixes: "synthetic+tenant"
  rollback_triggers: ["latency>2%","embed_drift>1%","cost>10%"]
```

tina_engineering: infra note: small canaries under-populate KV caches -> p99 noisy. recommend >=1% canary and synthetic prefix warmups. also need phased rollout orchestration to avoid capacity spikes.

sasha_research: will add golden prompt set per tenant and define metrics: exact-match, rerank-delta, embed-mean/std, and a composite quality score. will include warmup protocol.

opsbot: scheduled_canary tenant=tenant-482 start=3821110123 status=running.

maya_pm: rollout cadence: once pin enters 30d window, attempt canaries nightly across a 7d spread. if canary fails, hold pin and notify SE; if passes and tenant consented, schedule background roll with mid-roll opt-out support.

aj_dev: API work: GET/POST /pins/{tenant}/{model} to surface rollover config + recent canary results. Console: preview UI + run-now button. Epic will include metrics plumbing and rollout state machine.

sasha_research: i'll open bench spec PR with thresholds and warmup steps.

lucas_support: i'll draft tenant comms + credit tiers and provide a filter list for contractual exclusions.

maya_pm: launch checklist for PMs: bench spec merged, infra signoff on cache warming + orchestration, support comms & legal opt-out filter, API & console mock review. target: decision next sprint.

aj_dev: action items: aj -> epic + API contract EOW, tina -> infra design + cache warmup plan, sasha -> bench PR, lucas -> comms. tagging @tina_engineering for review. :thumbsup:
